stories.title: Mike Leigh se despide del cine con una Concha de Oro para 'Tender Loving Care'

en.title: Mike Leigh says goodbye to cinema with a Golden Shell for 'Tender Loving Care'
en.summary: British director Mike Leigh won the Golden Shell award at the 74th San Sebastián Film Festival for 'Tender Loving Care', which he stated would be his final film. The film demonstrates the characteristic charm that has defined Leigh's career.

stories.title: Mike Leigh se alza con la Concha de Oro en su conmovedora despedida del cine

en.title: Mike Leigh wins the Golden Shell in his moving farewell to cinema
en.summary: British director Mike Leigh won the Golden Shell award at the San Sebastián Film Festival with 'Tender Loving Care', a film about compassion and care. The victory marks a significant recognition at the festival.

stories.title: Mike Leigh entrega una obra maestra a la Concha de Oro del Festival de San Sebastián

en.title: Mike Leigh delivers a masterpiece to the Golden Shell of the San Sebastián Film Festival
en.summary: British director Mike Leigh won multiple awards including the Golden Shell at the San Sebastián Festival for 'Tender Loving Care', a film advocating compassion and care. Actor Javier Cámara also won best supporting actor.

stories.title: ‘Tender Loving Care’, la emocionante despedida de Mike Leigh, inapelable Concha de Oro en el festival de San Sebastián 2026

en.title: 'Tender Loving Care', the moving farewell of Mike Leigh, undisputed Golden Shell at the 2026 San Sebastián festival
en.summary: Mike Leigh's 'Tender Loving Care' won the Golden Shell at the 2026 San Sebastián Film Festival. Javier Cámara received the Silver Shell for best supporting performance in 'Cinco minutos más', while 'La bola negra' won the audience award.

stories.title: El Papa León XIV reivindica la «civilización del amor» con una misa multitudinaria en el corazón de París

en.title: Pope Leo XIV advocates for 'civilization of love' with massive mass in the heart of Paris
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV presided over a large mass at Paris's Place de la Concorde, which drew hundreds of thousands of attendees. The event took place in central Paris, a historically secular region.

stories.title: León XIV triunfa en París con una misa multitudinaria ante 800.000 personas

en.title: Leo XIV succeeds in Paris with a massive mass before 800,000 people
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV visited the Lourdes shrine and called for France to have generous leaders who respect human rights and build a society free from hatred, seven months before national elections.

en.title: Peón Kurtz, founder of Def Con Dos, dies at age 55
en.summary: José Costas Peón, known as Peón Kurtz and a founding member of the musical group Def Con Dos, died in Vigo. Reports indicate he suffered a heart attack.

stories.title: Sumar desafía al PSOE con un nuevo plante en el Consejo de Ministros por el decreto de vivienda

en.title: Sumar challenges PSOE with new standoff in Council of Ministers over housing decree
en.summary: The Sumar party threatens to boycott an upcoming government council meeting unless the PSOE includes a housing decree with specific provisions on rent freezes, eviction solutions, and restrictions on speculative rental practices.

stories.title: El papa León XIV reúne a 800.000 personas en la misa de París

en.title: Pope Leo XIV gathers 800,000 people at Paris mass
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV addressed a large gathering in Paris, encouraging France to renew itself based on its Christian roots.

stories.title: Sumar amenaza con un nuevo 'plantón' en el Consejo de Ministros si no se aprueba el decreto de vivienda

en.title: Sumar threatens new walkout from Cabinet if housing decree not approved
en.summary: The Sumar political coalition is warning it may boycott Cabinet sessions unless the government passes housing protection measures without compromises, including anti-eviction protections and rent extension policies.

en.title: Peón Kurtz, founding member of Def Con Dos, dies at age 55
en.summary: Peón Kurtz, a musician and founding member of Def Con Dos, has died at age 55. He was the brother of Miguel Costas, a former member of Siniestro Total.

en.summary: Ministers from the Sumar coalition warn they will boycott Cabinet meetings unless the government approves a housing decree addressing the residential crisis without partial or weakened measures.
